about_the_game:
DISCLAIMER: Once purchased, your albino alligator will appear at your ranch. To interact with it and take it into fights, you must first build a Pet House (unlocked at level 30), where all your pets are managed.

In the West, a true cowboy doesn’t stop at breaking horses—he tames the wild itself. From wolves to bears, the frontier is full of beasts to win over, but none take more grit, patience, and skill than an alligator. It’s the final challenge in the pet-taming trail, the one that proves you’ve truly mastered the wild.

This DLC lets you skip the long taming journey and claim the mightiest pet right away—and not just any gator. This snow-white albino is a rare frontier marvel, with a unique look that will live on in its offspring. Build a legendary breedline, turn heads wherever you go, and ride into town knowing no one’s gonna out-cool you now.

KEY FEATURES:

- Tier 4 Rare Pet with an Epic Shell perk (65% less damage received).

- Damage: 112–830 | Health: 500 | Max Health: 2395.

- Strong Genes: offspring inherit coat color and same tier/rarity.

- Bonus stats in Cypress Swale, Bayou, Salt Mine, and Cultist Camp.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 or 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel/AMD CPU with SSE2
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Graphics card with DirectX 10 support or better
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 1 GB available space

Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 or 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel/AMD CPU with SSE2
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
